claims.text: Surat’s 1800 agreement assigns Company revenue and justice powers while preserving specified Nawab first-instance proceedings. Bombay Port Authority describes a 1873 trustee board administering the port. These are different institutional competences. A port board is not an entire city government; treaty prescription establishes neither implementation nor consent.
